title: Ryab — a living map of the city
summary: A personal project exploring a city events map, now being rebuilt from scratch with a new architecture.
description: Ryab is a personal project for discovering and sharing information about what is happening in a city. I am rebuilding it from scratch with a new architecture. The journal follows the decisions and lessons as the new version takes shape.

sections.heading: The current direction
sections.body: The new version starts with information from city sources and aims to build a clearer picture of developing events. A local development environment and an initial API foundation are in place; the wider processing flow remains under development. I will share architectural decisions in the Ryab development journal.

sections.heading: Learning from an earlier version
sections.body: In an earlier development version, I directed a move from JavaScript / CPU media processing to WebGL. On the same hardware, inputs and models, frame processing fell from 1,445 to 196 ms, and one-minute video processing from 349 to 138 seconds. These are historical development benchmarks, not results for the new architecture or production traffic metrics.

sections.heading: My development process
sections.body: I use AI coding agents as part of development while remaining responsible for requirements, architecture, review and validation.
